name: groundhog
description: Find the work your agents keep re-doing by hand: mine transcripts for repeated procedures and re-learned lessons, keep a lessons ledger, and enforce it with hooks.
tagline: Stop re-living the same session: re-learned lessons become a committed ledger that hooks enforce, and repeated procedures become runbooks.
